text:
Ari (PM): Quick sync: proposing a 5-week "Shadow" design-partner pilot to validate Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching, quant profiles) for private deployments. Goal: 3 partners, at least one with production traffic. Need acceptance gates, incentive idea, and minimal feedback loop.
Lena (Solutions): Love it. suggest narrow scope: onboarding + one optimization rule applied (batching or quant). measure cost delta and latency impact.
Diego (Infra): We can carve out a "shadow" traffic mirror to apply suggestions non-disruptively. need partner consent and perf windows.
Sam (Eng): we should require partners to opt into nonblocking canary, and we will only surface suggestions; no auto-apply. that reduces risk.
Rhea (Design): capture partner confidence and perceived clarity of suggestions. I'll make a 1-page feedback form: perceived helpfulness (1-5), clarity (1-5), and 3 short bullets.
Ari (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria: 
- Legal: lightweight NDA + security questionnaire done
- Onboarding: sample inference + telemetry in <=7 days
- Observability: Optimize dashboard shows candidate suggestions and expected delta by week 2
- Validation: partner runs an A/B (shadow vs baseline) sample of 500 requests and reports cost/latency deltas
- Safety: no suggestion applied without partner sign-off
Lena (Solutions): Incentives: 1) waived infra for pilot, 2) 6x 1-hr office hours with Eng/Solutions, 3) early access pricing for first 3 months if they convert.
Diego (Infra): Perf windows: Tue/Thu 8-10am PT for load tests. we'll provide a load script: `python load.py --count 500 --route /v1/generate`
Sam (Eng): We'll export a lightweight harness and a sample JSON for the partner eval. Also include instructions on how to mirror traffic: `tcpdump` snippet or proxy config.
compliance-bot: Reminder: if partner traffic includes regulated PII, require DPA and additional controls.
Ari (PM): Feedback cadence: weekly async pulse + short 30m sync at mid-pilot. keep it low-friction.
Rhea (Design): I'll tag the qualitative feedback to map to product decisions: clarity, trust, adoption intent.
Lena (Solutions): Recruitment: pick 2 existing Dedicated customers and 1 startup that asked about cost optimization. direct invites first.
Ari (PM): Action items: Lena: outreach + intake form (48h); Rhea: feedback template + dashboard mock (48h); Diego: mirror/runbook + perf windows (48h); Sam: harness + load script (48h); compliance-bot/Legal: confirm NDA/DPA flow (48h); Ari: publish pilot brief + selection rubric (72h).
ops-bot: Reminder set for 48 hours.
Sam (Eng): One more note: define success metrics up front: average cost reduction >=10% with <=10% tail-latency increase, partners report helpfulness >=4/5, and at least 1 partner expresses intent to convert.
Ari (PM): Sounds good. we'll keep suggestions manual and transparent. I'll draft the partner email tonight and share for review. :thumbsup:
